model.name: RbDetailDrawer.closeAndMinimize impl
model.description: DESIGN-AHEAD (R27.8 REOPENED — full lifecycle, corrected). MEASURED root causes (rb-detail-drawer.ts): (1) X->close() :175 WRONG — Tron wants X->MINIMIZE (collapse-on-x). (2) '2nd-tap-removes' = NOT close(); minimize() :261 body:none+clear-height collapses to an INVISIBLE peek if [minimized] CSS has no visible bar (+onMouseUp :307 minimizes on tiny drag). (3) select-after-close: close() :140 doesnt clear panel.dataset.currentRef -> re-select SAME node reopens but renderDetailForRef :100 early-returns (stale); minimized+body:none linger. CORRECTED STATE MACHINE (Tron+HARD INVARIANT each-select-opens): closed->(sel)->open+minimized(peek)->(grab-bar)->expanded->(grab-bar)->peek; X->minimize; ESC->close; close->(sel)->REOPENS(peek). 5 FIXES: (a):175 X->minimize; (b) close() clear currentRef+removeAttribute(minimized)+restore body.display; (c) [minimized] CSS = VISIBLE clickable peek bar (restore); (d) select->ENSURE-open+show-node PRESERVING open-state (Tron ruling): setAttribute(minimized) ONLY when opening from CLOSED (`if (!this.hasAttribute(open)) setAttribute(minimized)`); if ALREADY open (peek OR expanded) do NOT touch minimized -> peek stays peek, expanded STAYS expanded; ALWAYS clear currentRef + set ref + re-render the new node. Invariant = ensure-open+show-node, NOT collapse-to-peek-always. NEVER force-collapse an expanded drawer; (e) onMouseUp :307 lands visible peek. Reuse R25.4 minimize/expand + R22.2 pan-zoom.
